craft_notes: FIRST-VERSE VOICE (verdict outstanding — same hand proposed for the whole song-set). Sthāyin: praise-wonder (adbhuta). Sanskrit first: yasyonmeṣa relative + stumaḥ close → L4 keeps invocation arc. Rows: row 1 (Śaṅkara-last). Rupture: dash after rise — praised, then named. Close: end-weight on the name. Minimal pass: 'dissolve and rise' for pralaya-udaya (same). Read aloud: whose? rise — praise. Rejected: 'tremor-lord' — killed: Śaṅkara kept (proper name); 'blink' for unmeṣa — killed: opening kept.

lines: By whose opening and closing the worlds dissolve and rise —
to him, power-wheel-glory's source: praise, Śaṅkara.
l4.sanskrit_cite: yasyonmeṣanimeṣābhyāṃ jagataḥ pralayodayau | taṃ śakticakravibhavaprabhavaṃ śaṅkaraṃ stumaḥ

reads_against.argmap: By opening-closing, worlds dissolve and emerge; to him, source of power-wheel glory — Śaṅkara praised.
c1_essence: Opening-closing: worlds dissolve-emerge; praised power-wheel source.
